gen-gf-baumans-gf-k2d: Commanding in its single-width strokes, Baumans sets a wide-mouthed c up top. And K2D follows with a tube-like body whose bends hold their thickness, so shrinking the heading would blunt the whole contrast.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-kantumruy-pro: Baumans leads with a wide-mouthed c and strokes that never change thickness, a heading with real presence and its own look. Kantumruy Pro stays open and approachable.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-kodchasan: Baumans draws every stroke at a single thickness, which gives its headings a bold, bent-tube stamp. Kodchasan, a plain sans, does the quieter job, leaving its terminals hanging open without any calligraphic thinning.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-koho: KoHo is a sans-serif with wide c apertures and hairline-free simplicity, a steady companion under the heading. Baumans gives it a bold, shadow-free top.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-lato: Tubing bent into letters, nothing more. Lato, a sans-serif with wide s curves barely curled in, takes over below and reads smoothly through paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-lunasima: Letters like a single neon tube, glowing and commanding. Lunasima, a sans-serif with c tips that never creep toward touching, handles the quiet work, while Baumans handles the loud one.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-m-plus-1p: Distinctive from the first glance, Baumans runs one stroke width through the whole alphabet. M PLUS 1p, a plain sans, then opens every curve end and lets the heading do the shouting.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-m-plus-2: Wire-bent letters with real presence. And M PLUS 2, a plain sans with a gaping c and one fixed nib width, would feel oversized if the body went large, so the heading stays dominant.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-momo-trust-sans: A wide-mouthed c in strokes of one thickness gives Baumans its stamp. Momo Trust Sans, a plain sans with heavy bowls and unclosed curves, reads friendly and smooth.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-monda: Commanding from its round, bent-wire letters, Baumans suits big statements, and Monda, a sans-serif with unclogged small counters, handles the careful reading beneath.
